reviews.text:
After more than two years of trusting Carlos, I can only say that he is an excellent veterinarian and, above all, a person who demonstrates immense love and dedication for animals. 🐾❤️
He has always treated my little one with patience, affection, and professionalism, explaining everything clearly and giving me great peace of mind. For me, he is undoubtedly one of the best veterinarians I have ever known.

Thank you, Carlos, for taking care of them as if they were your own. You are an amazing veterinarian! 🐶🐱❤️
Serious, reliable, efficient. A veterinarian you can trust.
We are extremely satisfied 🐕 with the attention and treatment we received; it was warm, friendly, and very professional. Delighted! Thank you! …

Highly recommended! We went for problems with my dog's ears and at the time they treated us with great care for the animal, applying the best treatment with several proposed options. Even though the dog was nervous at all times, it was treated with a lot of love and care. We are very happy. With the experience of prices from other veterinarians, we found the right price for the visit, treatment and products applied.
Carles Excellent veterinarian and even better person
Thank you to Carles for his attention, dedication, and sensitivity. A great professional and an even better person.

Dr. Carles and his team are incredibly dedicated to our furry friends. I went there a while ago with my cat, desperate after already being taken to an emergency veterinary hospital and paying a fortune for nothing… Dr. Carles quickly understood the problem, and after just one injection, she improved within a few hours, ending days of anguish. Even though I live on the other side of town, we always go to this clinic because we trust them.

Carles is an excellent veterinarian. Professional and a true animal lover. You won't feel like he's trying to rip you off like in most vet clinics. He treats you very fairly and carefully; he knows what he's doing. It was a very good experience. He didn't charge me for the diagnosis to remove a lipoma from my dog, nor for removing the stitches, which other places would have charged me for as a "visit" or "protocol" just to squeeze extra money out of me. He was very clear and attentive in explaining everything I needed to do post-operatively. I went back a few days later to check on him, and he examined him without any problem and prescribed more antibiotics and an anti-inflammatory ointment that was perfect for reducing the swelling of the wound. Although the operation was a little complicated because it turned out to be an infiltrative lipoma and they had to cut some muscle tissue, Carles and Raquel did an excellent job. The dog is already jumping and running after two weeks; he has recovered perfectly. It's clear he cares about his patients and clients... He's become my vet for the duration of my stay in Barcelona. Thank you so much 😊

We have known Carles for many years. Always professional and kind to animals. Very good treatment and a lot of empathy in all aspects. He took care of Brat, our Golden, and now our water dogs.
Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic in the neighborhood.

This is a trustworthy dog ​​clinic!

My dog ​​suddenly had an allergic reaction and his whole face swelled up. We didn't hesitate to come to this clinic, which a friend recommended.

Dr. Carles and his assistant gave the dog an injection right away while calming him down throughout the treatment. They were very professional and attentive. Five hours later, my dog ​​was completely back to normal.

They are very caring with my dog. They carefully explained the details of the subsequent medication and patiently answered all our questions.

A few days later, when the dog vomited blood after eating plastic, we went back to the clinic. After seeing the dog's condition, they gave us professional advice free of charge. They provided professional guidance, both for the dog and for us, with a lot of care.

A trustworthy dog ​​clinic!

Carles, the vet, is a great professional who treats animals with love and respect, prioritizing their well-being without inflating the bill.
I've been taking my 12-year-old cat there since she was a kitten. I'm very happy.

I've been taking my kitten there for a year now. Dr. Pujol is very kind. I like that it's a small clinic; they've always been careful to make sure my cat doesn't see or come into contact with any other canine patients to avoid stressing him out.
Finally found a veterinarian in Barcelona that I trust and my dogs like 💕 …

Schedules are not followed on weekends. If you don't have an appointment, they'll give you one if they can squeeze you in later.
Decent service.
Carles is an incredible professional who shows that he loves every animal that comes into his clinic. He doesn't inflate bills and is completely trustworthy. Totally recommended
